title: OpenAI lets businesses claim profiles in ChatGPT and publish their own agents there
summary: OpenAI opened a beta Business Hub where companies can claim a profile inside ChatGPT and see how people engage with it. Eligible ecommerce and online service businesses can also publish a business agent that answers customer questions inside ChatGPT, and those agents can be promoted through ChatGPT ads. On November 19 OpenAI extended eligibility to businesses outside the U.S. TechCrunch describes the move as a step toward making ChatGPT work more like a search and discovery engine for local and online businesses.
why: Customers are starting to find businesses inside AI assistants, so claiming your profile and keeping its details accurate is becoming as basic as a Google Business listing.
